verdict.rationale: Dover is an ATS that offers a public API, so asking whether it has a sandbox or test environment is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, or any way to isolate testing from production data. The API docs and the llms.txt probe describe API capabilities but say nothing about test environments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
